description: An empty stadium at dusk or night, seen from the stage. A single vintage microphone on a stand sits under a bright spotlight beam in the middle of the stage floor. The rows of dark seats are empty, with red scarves draped over some and red ribbons scattered across seats and the floor. Black cables coil across the stage, and a small white object lies near the mic base. Floodlight towers and two tall buildings are on the skyline. No visible text, no frame, no people.
reason: The scene asked for a vast crowd with arms raised, but the painting shows a completely empty stadium with no people. Nothing specific to a Wembley tribute concert for Freddie Mercury appears, so it could be any empty stadium stage. The red ribbons and scarves are a possible AIDS-awareness nod but are not clearly identifiable. A redraw with a crowd, or a clearer tribute cue, is needed.
